The guy's leading a group that challenges the official election story, and he already admitted back in 2022 he was only showing how simple it is to game the whole voter system. Now the authorities are rushing to label it fraud so they can shut him down and shield the real operators behind the scenes. It's obvious this is a coordinated move by the hidden elites and institutions to bury anyone exposing the loose setup they can't afford to have scrutinized, since that would reveal exactly who's really pulling the strings.
